# intenter update

Check for a new release and install it

Shows what is available and updates Intenter to it: the release's signed
checksums are verified with the key built into this binary, the download is
verified against them, the executable is replaced atomically and the daemon
is restarted into the new version. Nothing changes on a failed check.
Installations owned by Homebrew or winget are handed to that tool instead.

## Usage

```text
intenter update [flags]
```

## Examples

```console
intenter update --check
intenter update
intenter update --version 0.2.0 --yes
intenter update --skip 0.2.0
```

## Options

| Flag | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--allow-downgrade` | — | permit --version to install an older release |
| `--channel` `<string>` | — | override the release channel (stable or prerelease) |
| `--check` | — | check now and print the status |
| `--plan` | — | print what an update would do, and change nothing |
| `--skip` `<string>` | — | never offer this version again |
| `--unskip` | — | undo a --skip |
| `--version` `<string>` | — | install a specific version instead of the newest |
| `-y`, `--yes` | — | do not ask for confirmation |
